EXAMPLE BOARD · The content is made up, to show how Clewbert works. Change it, talk to it, or delete it.
Clewbert is a brainstorming partner you talk to, with an agent team behind you. Bring in notes, links, videos, PDFs and files, ask about them out loud, and hand the work to your team.
1. Bring in anything: PDFs, files, pictures, videos, links

items.label: team-roles.md
items.preview:
# Your agent team

Every board has a team. You can rename them, change their jobs in plain words, and add teammates under **Agents** (top right).

## Lead
Reads your task and the board, splits the work into parts, and hands each part to a teammate. When the parts are done, the Lead writes the final answer in the task's frame.

## Researcher
Searches the web, reads pages and documents, and puts what it finds on the board as notes and link cards, each with where it came from.

items.text: Paste a screenshot or a link with ⌘V. Drag in any file: PDFs, pictures, videos, documents.
Press N for a sticky note and T for text. Double-click a note to type in it.
Drag a frame by its title to move it. Everything inside the frame moves with it.
Clewbert reads everything you put here, including the words inside screenshots and PDFs. That is what it talks about.
Ask: "What does the quick guide PDF say about privacy?"
2. Talk to it: build your first team
Click the microphone at the top of the toolbar on the left, allow the microphone, and just talk.
Try saying: "What is on this board?"
Try saying: "Open the YouTube link."
Try saying: "Who is on my agent team, and what does each one do?"
Answers come only from what is on your boards, and the items it used light up.
No microphone? Type your question in the "Or type a question" box instead.
3. Hand a task to your team
Press A (the agent button on the left). Select what the team should work from, say what to do, and press Start.
The task becomes a frame on the board. The Lead hands parts to teammates. Each part gets its own frame, joined by an arrow.
When the team needs you, its question shows up on the board and under Tasks. Answer it there or out loud.
Agents always ask before anything that sends, buys, books, posts or signs up.
Click Agents at the top right to see your team of agents. Add teammates and describe their jobs in plain words.
Press A and say: "Turn the quick guide and the team roles into a one-page plan for my first week."
4. Find your way around
To change which model or voice Clewbert uses, click the gear on the home page (Settings).
Boards live in spaces, like folders. The example boards are in the Examples space.
Click the back arrow at the top left for the list of boards. Talk from there to ask across all your boards.
Space+drag or a two-finger scroll moves around. ⌘-scroll zooms. Fit shows the whole board.
Start your own board with New board on the home page. These examples are yours to change or delete.
